ask: muse can u make a tracker for this so we can check in every day
sentence: A daily check-in tracker for a fixed-length group pact where each person ticks off each day, misses add money to a shared pot, and one person advances the day.
use_when: A group wants to check in once a day for a set number of days
Friends want a small money stake that grows when someone misses a day
A study, workout or habit pact needs a shared view of who is on track
One person should keep count and move the group to the next day
dont_use_when: Splitting a bill or tracking who owes whom
A one-time vote or poll between options
A solo habit tracker with no group or stake
A pact with a different length, buy-in or miss cost than the fixed one
